data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 abstracts SRC_002: the sufficiency-condition framing in SRC_004 is the more general modal structure, of which reflexivity (a guard that catches the author's own mutation) is a special case of a test being sufficient for acceptance of only the surviving subject. Refuted if SRC_004's sufficiency condition can hold while SRC_002's reflexive guard condition fails to instantiate it in the compile.py case.
